svg.title: Multimodal RAG over Attention Is All You Need
svg.desc: One pipeline over the text, tables and figures of a single PDF in one ChromaDB store. Retrieved figures go to the LLM as images, so answers are grounded in the diagrams too. 28+ edge cases handled.
